description: Social inbox DM conversations for Instagram and Facebook Page inboxes (Threads has no DMs; Pro plan or higher plus posts:read). Without conversation_id: list conversations filtered by account, platform, unread/starred/archived, search, or since/until dates, with limit/offset paging. With conversation_id: one conversation and its messages; there limit is the number of messages (default 50, max 100) and only workspace_id may be added. When a sync has stored it, each conversation includes the Meta reply window (open until a UTC time, or closed). A reply does not extend that window, and it is not guessed from the messages loaded in the thread.

platform.description: Instagram or Facebook. Threads has comments, not DMs.

search.description: Search participant username or last message preview.

workspace_id.description: Omit to search all your workspaces, or pass an ID from whoami.

name: list_conversations
